title: issue.reveal_decided
description: The reporter allowed or refused fields (`decideIssueReveal`). `node_id` of the entry is the issue node. The actor is the bearer of the issue receipt token (kind `issue_receipt`, id = the issue node), with `on_behalf_of` null: the reporter is not a member, and naming the app would record the reporter's privacy decision as the app's own act (decision 0006, open question 24). A member who reported decides as a user. Field names and choices only, never values. This schema is the `data` of a journal entry with `type` `issue.reveal_decided`. Step 3, planned (decision 0004-21, docs/STEP3.md).
